title: [RIDGELINE] SHŌWA COLOSSUS — A Jazz Kissa Pop-up
content:
Ridgeline subscribers —

From next Wednesday, November 25, I’m starting a new pop-up newsletter: SHŌWA㍼COLOSSUS — a tour of the last remaining classic jazz kissas of Kyūshū. It will run for about twenty-one days and then, like any good pop-up, all your emails will be deleted.

Sign up for SHŌWA㍼COLOSSUS here:

Subscribe

SHŌWA㍼COLOSSUS is a continuation of my BASIE!BOP!JAMAICA! tour from 2023, where I visited jazz kissas in Tōhoku and Hokkaidō. This time we’re going south (or west, as Kyūshū sits in my mind).
